verdict.rationale: Cal.com supports event-triggered automation via webhooks (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, etc.) that can call external actions, plus routing forms/workflows referenced in docs, giving a rule-like trigger-action mechanism for AI-native users to configure. However this is webhook/workflow configuration rather than a full expressive 'if X then Y' rules engine with conditional logic, and no hands-on/independent evidence confirms reliability of custom automation chains in practice. missing for 10: evidence of conditional/multi-step rule logic beyond simple trigger enums, independent/hands-on confirmation that webhook-driven automations work reliably, and documentation of workflow customization depth for AI-defined rules.
